_comment: Cargo target dir by worktree dir name (.claude/worktrees/<name>), read by .claude/hooks/session-env.sh; "*" is every other folder, the main checkout included. Since 2026-11-20 every folder shares one target, so cargo's build-directory lock runs one build at a time on this PC (owner's decision). D:/fyx-targets is a junction to E:/fyx-targets on the Dev Drive. .claude/hooks/guard-commands.sh denies cargo builds into any other target dir.
